sections.title: Speech provider
sections.description: Windows system speech is free and works offline. ElevenLabs is optional and uses your own account and API usage.

controls.label: Windows voice name (optional)
controls.description: Leave blank for the Windows default voice.

controls.label: ElevenLabs API key
controls.description: Encrypted for this Windows account and excluded from exports. On Linux it is retained only until Forge exits.

sections.title: TTS automations
sections.description: Templates may use variables supplied by a trigger, including {user}, {input}, and {reward} from Twitch Redeems.
